svg.title: SkillForge skill memory
svg.desc: Skills are created, stored, graded and only injected into a turn once they carry at least one grade with a mean above zero. Automatic grades are capped at 0.3; user follow-ups also grade. 3 of 99 skills pass the gate today.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Skill memory: nothing is injected until it has earned a grade
